title: Align canonical compiler prerequisites for Boolean compatibility collapse

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Implement only the three compiler-side prerequisites frozen by GPU-69 before deleting the duplicate Boolean compatibility projector: exact selected-hyperedge conflict shape, early explicit endpoint-completeness admission, and canonical snapshot-plane reuse without plane_map materialization.

changes: For an explicitly selected same-plane signature, a same-relation ForestHyperedge conflicts only when all members are in exactly that plane; selected cross-plane signatures still conflict when both endpoint planes participate.

Explicit endpoint completeness is admitted immediately after signature validation and before Forest hyperedge/edge relation scans; discover-all still validates completeness after signatures are discovered.
The compiler reuses the canonical snapshot.planes tuple for node locations, retained-relation lookup, completeness lookup, and TypedAxis construction instead of allocating snapshot.plane_map.
No helper, cache, registry, graph authority, projector, backend, public API, fact store, or parallel abstraction was introduced.

focused_regressions: same-plane selection ignores an unrelated same-relation cross-plane hyperedge instead of over-refusing
an explicitly selected incomplete endpoint refuses before canonical relation hashing can begin
explicit compilation succeeds when FourfoldSnapshot.plane_map is monkeypatched to refuse materialization
